contract:
Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::deleteLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstances()->any(t: LoanTerm|t.ItemID = itemid)
	precondition:
		LoanTerm.allInstances()->exists(t: LoanTerm|t.ItemID = itemid)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		LoanTerm.allInstances()->excludes(term)
}
